name: public-blind-relay R-5: same-NAT peers connect through the default relay (committed harness scripts/relay/drill, re-run on committed fail-closed fix d181473c10)
summary: Re-run of the R-5 live drill after the relay fail-closed fix landed at d181473c10. Before the run, HEAD was d181473c10 and sync-relay.ts, voice-relay.ts, scripts/relay/drill/run.sh and scripts/relay/drill/peer.mts each had a working-tree blob identical to HEAD (meta.txt CLEAN lines). Setup: two peers in separate network namespaces behind the tower's one public IP, with no route between them, join one hyperswarm topic through the shipped sync-relay module. Both arms unset PAPERCUSP_VOICE_RELAY_KEYS. Control arm (PAPERCUSP_RELAY_DEFAULTS=0) has no relay key and never connects. Defaults arm (PAPERCUSP_RELAY_DEFAULTS=1) uses the shipped default key b1015b56, and both peers record a relayed connection through the e2-micro relay. Plan public-blind-relay-2026-10-01 clause AUTO-BAR-R-5-P-004. Per-arm JSONL: .papercusp/scratch/relay-live-rerun/drill-out/.
